question: Heal in India is an initiative of the Indian Government aimed at promoting ____________ in the country.
solution:
The correct answer is **__medical tourism__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The goals of the Heal in India campaign are to increase medical tourism in India and establish the nation as a global leader in health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• With the goals of **"Seva"** and **"Atithi Devo Bhava"** in mission mode, the Indian government is committed to making India the world's leading destination for **medical and wellness tourism**.
 
• **MoHFW, India,** has created the **Medical Value Travel Digital Portal** to facilitate the treatment of** international patients** visiting India as part of the** "Heal in India" campaign**, which seeks to promote** medical value travel **in the nation.
 
• **Traveling and accommodating a foreign visitor** who spends **at least one night** in the destination area with the intention of **preserving, enhancing, or regaining health **through medical intervention can be categorized a**s medical value travel**.
 
• The health ministry is now reviewing **1,097 **logo concepts that have been submitted by the general public.
 
• The logo had to be designed with beautiful arrangements in the **national tricolour**, representing the **core of the Heal in India identity** and reflecting the organization's mission to a worldwide audience.
